newsitem.title: USA: Qualcomm gets $50 mln Sprint PCS contract.
newsitem.headline: Qualcomm gets $50 mln Sprint PCS contract.

text.p: Qualcomm Inc said Tuesday it has signed an agreement to sell more than $50 million worth of its code division multiple access (CDMA) PCS Q phones to Sprint Corp's Sprint PCS unit.
The agreement provides Sprint PCS with Q phones for distribution throughout Sprint PCS' nationwide CDMA digital network, Qualcomm said. Shipments are scheduled to begin this summer.

The phones will be co-labeled with the Qualcomm and Sprint brands, Qualcomm said. Sprint PCS will distribute Qualcomm's Q phones to customers through Sprint PCS retail stores and direct sales channels, as well as major retail and electronics stores.
